verdict.rationale: Zoom's AI Services auth docs describe issuing API credentials with chosen API scopes, an expiration option, and an IP allowlist. Short-lived JWTs that avoid exposing the secret are also documented. Together these are least-privilege credential controls suitable for an agent. Missing for 10: detail on how fine-grained the per-endpoint scopes are, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: IP allowlist. Enter any IP addresses that you want to allow
Use a short-lived JWT for client-to-backend API calls. A JWT expires quickly and doesn't expose your secret.
